messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident triggered: latency_slo_breach (p95/p99) on serving-cluster-eu-west-1. Alerts: streaming stalls up, tail latency spikes, KV cache evictions increased 8x. Auto-page to #eng-sre and #eng-runtime.

maria g: seeing p95 jump from 120ms -> 800ms and p99 to ~2.3s on streaming endpoints. Dash: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/latency (link).

aj: noticed large increase in `kv_prefill_evictions` and `decode_worker_queue_len`. Prefill rate stayed constant but decode throughput dropped.

sylvie: any customer-facing errors? support-bot, do we have uptick in 504s/timeouts?
support-bot: Support: ~0.6% of requests returning 504s in last 10m, top hit customers: acme-app (impacting interactive chat features), list sent to SEs.

chris: log tail from a victim shard:
```
2026-03-15T21:03:12Z [warn] kv: eviction triggered shard=shard-17 free=9MB threshold=64MB
2026-03-15T21:03:12Z [info] handler: prefill_enqueue key=ctx_abc len=1024
2026-03-15T21:03:13Z [info] handler: decode_worker_busy id=decode-7 waiting=47
2026-03-15T21:03:14Z [error] streaming: stall detected req_id=xyz duration=3.2s
```

maria g: that matches my hypothesis: fragmentation -> prefill fragments lots of small allocations -> eviction churn -> decode workers starve leading to streaming tail stalls. Prefill vs decode imbalance.

aj: confirmed KV slab utilization uneven across shards, shard-17/19/21 worst. Patch we rolled last week increased small-allocation rate. Could be related.

sylvie: immediate mitigations?

chris: propose 3-step live mitigation:
1) enable eviction backpressure on worst shards (prevent prefill enqueue)
2) temporarily reduce prefill parallelism (config: `prefill.max_workers` from 64 -> 16)
3) fallback: route streaming to quantized model variant on gateway for 10m if stalls persist

maria g: +1. Also add a rapid slab-reshuffle job to rebalance hot keys across shards (best-effort, non-blocking).

aj: I'm on 1) and 2). Pushing throttling patch now.

devon: I'll open a quick feature-flag so we can toggle `prefill.max_workers` without a full deploy. Putting flag on safe path.

sylvie: who is owning customer comms? If we do fallback, need to notify affected SEs + support and list expected behavior (slightly different embeddings, lower throughput).
support-bot: SEs notified for acme-app and 3 other customers, templates ready.

chris: Pushing commands to enable backpressure on affected shards:
```
# redwoodctl cache backpressure enable --shards shard-17,shard-19,shard-21 --threshold 0.75
# redwoodctl config set prefill.max_workers=16 --ff prefill-reduce-2026-03-15
```

maria g: logs show eviction count starting to drop 30s after backpressure, decode queue length slowly falling. p95 already improved ~250ms in the last minute.

aj: starting the slab-reshuffle as background job, it's rate-limited (no node disruption). Job id: reshuffle-20260315-1.

sylvie: metrics to watch: `kv_prefill_enqueued`, `kv_evictions`, `decode_worker_queue_len`, `streaming_stall_rate`, `p95_streaming` — set alerts to 1.5x baseline.

devon: feature-flag toggled, prefill workers set to 16. Rolling across region: eu-west-1.

chris: so far mitigation sequence outcome:
- backpressure enabled at 21:06 UTC
- prefill worker throttle at 21:07 UTC
- slab reshuffle started at 21:09 UTC
- p95 decreased from 800ms -> 210ms by 21:12 UTC
- p99 decreased from 2.3s -> 780ms by 21:12 UTC
- streaming stalls reduced from 5% -> 0.9%

maria g: great. Next steps: keep backpressure for 15 more minutes, monitor for regression, then gradually ramp prefill workers back to baseline with slab reshuffle completed. Also schedule RCA for root cause of small allocation surge (deploy from last week).

aj: assigning post-incident follow-up to @aj (investigate last week's patch and heap alloc patterns), @chris (shard rebalance improvements), @sylvie (alert tuning/customer comms).

devon: handing off to night on-call — @sylvie will be primary. I'll leave commands and rollback steps in the runbook.
sylvie: taking handoff. If we see repeat within 30m, plan is to roll model -> quantized fallback and open incident page.

maria g: thanks all. Quick note for the oncall diary: probable cause = KV fragmentation + prefill->decode imbalance, mitigation = backpressure + prefill throttle + slab reshuffle. We'll keep this in incidents log. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: Sev2. Handoff: sylvie. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/1815556666

support-bot: Customer comms: initial message sent to affected customers, product team drafting follow-up with timeline.

sylvie: I'll update the incident page with timeline and assign RCA tickets. Handoff complete. :thumbsup:
